title: Singleton Pattern Examples
description: Runnable Singleton implementations: thread-safe Python __new__, Python module-level, Java enum singleton, double-checked locking, Bill Pugh holder, and a TypeScript registry with test reset.
description_es: Implementaciones ejecutables de Singleton: __new__ thread-safe en Python, instancia a nivel de módulo, enum singleton de Java, double-checked locking, holder de Bill Pugh y un registro TypeScript con reset para tests.
